subject: SEC: syncProgress accepts ANY non-gate achievement id from the client
description:
Found by Mallory during the 364 audit, 2026-09-08. PRE-EXISTING, not introduced by 364. functions/index.js ~1716: syncProgress filters client-supplied achievements with ONLY .filter(a => !/^(gate_\d+|dark_arts_gate\d+)$/.test(a)). Modules and labs get shape validation AND a registry check (_isValidModuleId + _isKnownCompletion); achievements get a two-pattern blacklist and nothing else. So any signed-in account (anonymous sign-in qualifies) can call syncProgress with {achievements:['anything']} and have it written permanently to users/{uid}.achievements via the admin SDK, which bypasses firestore.rules entirely - the BUG-262/263 rules fix closed DIRECT client writes but not this callable. Impact: mints 0 XP (deriveXP pays only gate_*), and HomeDirectory.js:130 already treats server_awards as the tamper-evident store against achievements, so it is detectable. But it means 'present in achievements' is NOT evidence of having earned anything, platform-wide, today - relevant to any future consumer that reads it, including credentials. Fix shape: apply the same registry-style validation achievements currently lack, mirroring what _isKnownCompletion does for modules/labs. Chris independently confirmed the finding.
[2026-09-08 22:12] CLOSED as WONTFIX (registry) + FIXED (the real leak), 2026-09-08. Four-way review: Nancy BLOCK on any enforcement path, Chris DON'T BUILD, Mallory DON'T BUILD, primary agreed. Evidence: 325 config-literal achievement ids across 358 files, ALL undeclared and invisible to a literal unlock() sweep, on a field deriveXP pays 0 XP for - a registry reproduces the BUG-264 outage (which is still why _ENFORCE_COMPLETION_REGISTRY is false) for a cosmetic payoff. Mallory swept every consumer: deriveXP gate-patterns only, leaderboard ranks by server XP, all four CSV exports and calculateRiskScore never read achievements, tournament badges already encode proven-vs-claimed. Nothing load-bearing reads the raw array. Chris's condition for accepting the WONTFIX is DONE: PublicProfile.syncMyStats now publishes achievementCount from users/{uid}/server_awards (CF-written, no client write rule) instead of the client-writable achievements array, and omits the field on a read error rather than zeroing a real count. Do NOT reopen the registry idea without re-deriving why it failed - the reasoning is in the commit and in this note.
